fill-description: Base, hover, and focus states use the 500 / 700 / 400 stops from the brand and semantic scales. Disabled buttons switch to whiteScale/blackScale tokens for consistent contrast.
outline-description: Outline buttons layer whiteScale surfaces with the same brand and semantic color for their strokes and text. Hover and focus stay grounded on whiteScale tokens while the border stays on the 500 value.
sizes-description: Each token pairs a font-size with the requested padding values so spacing stays consistent across variants.
icon-description: Buttons can render an icon on either side while maintaining the 5px gap defined in the component.
